tagline: Auto-save Zoom recordings and notes to organized Google Drive folders
metaTitle: Zoom + Google Drive Integration: Recordings Saved to Drive
metaDescription: Upload Zoom recordings to Google Drive, file them by project or team, and save transcripts as Drive docs. GAIA keeps your archive tidy. See the setup steps.
intro:
Zoom recordings pile up in the cloud without organization, making it hard to find a specific call weeks later. Google Drive is where most teams already store their documents and shared files, yet recordings never land there automatically.

GAIA moves recordings to Drive as soon as they're ready and organizes them into folders by meeting name, date, or project. Your team always knows exactly where to find a recording, and that one archive holds both documents and video.

useCases.title: Auto-upload Zoom recordings to Google Drive
useCases.description: When a recording is processed, GAIA uploads it to the designated folder automatically. No manual downloading and re-uploading required.

useCases.title: Organize recordings by project or team folder
useCases.description: GAIA routes recordings to different folders based on the meeting name or host. Client calls go to the client folder; internal standups go to the team folder.

useCases.title: Save meeting transcripts as Drive documents
useCases.description: GAIA converts the transcript into a Google Doc and saves it alongside the recording. The searchable text doc makes it easy to find specific moments without scrubbing video.

useCases.title: Share folder links in meeting follow-up emails
useCases.description: After saving a recording, GAIA sends a follow-up email to meeting participants with the Drive link. Everyone has instant access without requesting permissions manually.

howItWorks.step: Connect Zoom and Google Drive to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Zoom account and Google Drive. Specify the root folder where recordings should be stored.
Configure how GAIA names and organizes folders, by meeting title, date, host, or a combination. GAIA creates subfolders automatically as new meeting series appear.
When processing finishes, GAIA transfers the recording and applies your folder rules. Your video archive stays organized without any manual intervention.

faqs.question: Does GAIA delete the recording from Zoom after saving it to Drive?
faqs.answer: By default, GAIA saves the file and leaves the cloud recording intact. You can optionally configure GAIA to delete the original after a successful upload to manage storage limits.

faqs.question: How long does it take for a recording to appear?
faqs.answer: GAIA uploads the recording as soon as processing finishes, which typically takes 5–30 minutes after the meeting ends depending on length. You'll receive a notification when it's available.

faqs.question: Can GAIA handle recordings from multiple hosts in one organization?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA supports multiple hosts within the same organization and can route each host's recordings to a separate folder based on the host's identity.
